It is not training-induced recurrence, as it requires explicit structural changes.

The paper focuses on empowering transformers with algorithmic capabilities, demonstrating performance in tasks that require multi-step computation and algorithm representation (e.g., iterative optimization algorithms), aligning with the Applications and Capabilities category for solving complex, structured tasks.

The paper provides theoretical evidence of the expressive power of AlgoFormer in solving challenging problems, mirroring human-designed algorithms, which relates to investigating theoretical computational capabilities, though it is more specific to algorithmic structures rather than a general proof of Turing completeness.
